'''''Starflash''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] series created by [[J'fe Din]]. The show was actually a means of transmitting codes, passwords and messages to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents working in the [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]]. None of the information was ever apparent to the show's billions of fans because J'fe and her [[Unidentified producer|producer]] always concealed the data in background widescreens or crate labels. The show was the farthest reaching messenger that the Rebels had, and it managed to quicken the downfall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] by a year in the Larrin sector.
